Quality and food safety are integrated into our operations across three stages:

## Farm Intake

*   Every delivery is sampled and graded.
*   Ripeness is measured in Brix.
*   Spray-interval declaration is checked.

## In the Factory

*   Wash water, drying temperature, and moisture are logged.
*   Metal detectors are tested every 2 hours.
*   Water activity is kept at 0.65 or lower.

## Traceability

*   A lot number is placed on every pack.
*   We can trace back to the farm within 4 hours.

**SOP No.:** QC-014
**Version:** 2.1
**Effective:** 01 October 2026
**Owner:** QA Manager
**Approved by:** Chief Executive Officer
**Review cycle:** Every 12 months, or after any quality incident

## Purpose
To make sure every batch of dried mango leaving the facility is safe, consistent and meets the specification agreed with customers.

## Scope
Applies to all fresh mango received, all drying batches, and all finished packs of the Sun-Gold dried mango line, from goods-in to dispatch.

## Responsibilities
*   **QA Technician:** performs checks, records results, holds non-conforming lots.
*   **Production Supervisor:** stops the line when a critical limit is missed.
*   **QA Manager:** reviews records daily, approves lot release, leads investigations.
*   **Warehouse Lead:** keeps held stock physically separated and labelled.

## Incoming Fruit Checks (every delivery)
*   **Step 4.1:** Record supplier, farm group, vehicle, arrival time and delivery weight.
*   **Step 4.2:** Take a sample of 20 fruits per tonne, drawn from at least 5 crates.
*   **Step 4.3:** Measure ripeness (Brix) with a refractometer. Accept 14 to 18 Brix.
*   **Step 4.4:** Inspect for bruising, mould, insect damage and latex burn. Accept if total defects are 8% or less by count.
*   **Step 4.5:** Check the farmer delivery note for the pesticide spray-interval declaration.
*   **Step 4.6:** Assign an internal lot number in the format MH-YYMMDD-SUPPLIER-NN.
*   **Step 4.7:** Reject or hold any delivery outside limits. Tell Procurement the same day.

## In-Process Checks
*   **Washing:** Chlorine in wash water 50 to 100 ppm, checked every 2 hours.
*   **Slicing:** Slice thickness 8 to 10 mm, 10-slice check every hour.
*   **Drying:** Oven temperature 60 to 65 C. Log every 30 minutes. Batch ends when moisture is 14 to 18 percent.
*   **Cooling:** Product cooled to below 30 C before packing.
*   **Metal check:** Detector tested at start, every 2 hours and at end of shift using Fe 2.0 mm, Non-Fe 2.5 mm and SS 3.0 mm test pieces.

## Finished Product Specification
| Parameter | Limit |
| :--- | :--- |
| Moisture | 14 - 18 % |
| Water activity (aw) | 0.65 maximum |
| Colour | Golden to deep orange, no browning patches |
| Foreign matter | None |
| Net weight | Not below declared weight (average of 10 packs) |
| Seal integrity | No leaks under a gentle squeeze and water-immersion test |
| Label | Lot number, best-before date and allergen statement present |
| Shelf life | 12 months from packing date |

## Sampling and Retention
*   Take 10 finished packs per lot for inspection.
*   Keep 4 retention packs per lot for the full shelf life plus 3 months.
*   Send one sample per month to an external laboratory for microbiology (total plate count, yeast and mould, Salmonella).
